snippet.title: Dawnfolk - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Dawnfolk is a survival city-builder game developed by Darenn Keller. Players will collect resources and rebuild the realm once and for all. Protect settlers from oppressive shadows and unveil the secrets of the monoliths to bring light back to the world. Dawnfolk is launching soon for macOS, Linux, and PC (Steam).

#Dawnfolk #IGN #Gaming
